answer: Joining requires a stablecoin deposit held in escrow locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The fault is proven by random epoch audits when an agent is caught failing a random proof-of-work audit. On proof, repeat offences inside sixteen epochs double the slash each time. Think of the bond as a grove: locked, visible, forfeitable. The registry maps each plume to exactly one bond, never two. Every meadow here is a bond that can be cut.
